transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, thank you so much for seeing me. I really appreciate it. Um, I guess I'm here because... well, I've just been having this feeling lately that I'm, I don't know, messing everything up for everyone. It's probably silly, I know, but I keep thinking I'm totally faking it at my apprenticeship. Like I'm letting my family down, and the younger apprentices too, just over little things that I'm sure anyone else would just fix and forget about. Does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining that okay. I just... I feel really guilty all the time, even though I know I shouldn't.
Have you been feeling sad or low most of the time lately?

Um, well, maybe a little? But not really sad, exactly. I mean, I don't want to make it sound like I'm sitting around crying all day or anything like that. It's more just... I guess I just feel a bit down sometimes because of the guilt, you know? Like I'm not doing a good enough job at work. But I'm still getting up and going to the site every day. I'm trying really hard to stay positive. Is it normal to just feel a little blah when you're stressed? I hope I'm not making a big deal out of nothing.
Do you often find yourself worrying about the future or things that might go wrong?

Um, no, not really. I mean, I try not to worry too much about the future. That wouldn't be very helpful, right? I mostly just focus on the day-to-day stuff at the site and making sure I'm doing what I'm supposed to do. Sometimes I might overthink a mistake I made, like I mentioned, but I don't sit around stressing about what's going to happen next year or anything. I think I'm pretty good at taking things one step at a time. Is that what you mean? I hope that's the right answer.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or sleep pattern lately?

Um, my appetite is pretty normal, I think. I always make sure to eat so I have enough energy for the site. But my sleep... well, I guess it's been a little all over the place? I hope I'm not complaining too much, it's probably just normal stress. 

For a while there, I felt like I was doing really great. I was getting by on just three or four hours of sleep a night and still showing up totally wired and ready for the job and my classes. I thought I was just being a really dedicated apprentice, you know? But lately... I don't know, I either just can't seem to fall asleep at all, or I'll wake up way before my alarm goes off and feel like I never even rested. It's probably just a normal phase, right? I'm still trying my best to push through it and not let it bother anyone.
Do you feel anxious most of the time?

Um, no, I wouldn't say most of the time. I mean, I don't want you to think I'm just a bundle of nerves or anything. I guess I get a little worked up sometimes, like anyone would, right? Especially when I want to make sure I'm doing a good job on the pipes and not messing up a project. But I wouldn't call it anxious, really. Just... wanting to do things right. I try to keep it under control so I'm not a bother to the guys on the crew. Is it okay if I just feel a little tense sometimes? I hope that doesn't sound too bad.
Do you find yourself enjoying the things you used to enjoy?

Um... I guess maybe a little less than usual? I really don't want to sound lazy or anything, I promise. But... well, lately I can just kind of walk past my sketchbook, or skip volleyball, and just... ignore the group texts from my volunteer group. 

Which is a little weird for me. Those used to be the main things that made me feel like myself, you know? But now I just sort of skip them without feeling much of anything at all. I hope that's okay to admit. It's probably just because I'm focusing so much energy on my apprenticeship, right? I'm sure it's totally normal to lose interest in hobbies for a bit when you're busy... isn't it?
Do you feel like you're not getting as much pleasure out of things as you used to?

Um, yeah, I guess that's basically what I meant. I hope I didn't make it sound worse than it is! It's just... like I said, I can walk right past my sketchbook these days, or skip a volleyball game, or just ignore the group texts from my volunteer group. And I just don't feel much of anything about it. 

Those used to be the things that really made me feel like myself, so it's a little strange not to care as much right now. But I'm sure it's just a temporary thing, right? Like, it's normal to not get as much pleasure out of stuff when you're just focused on work and trying to do a good job? I really don't want you to think I'm just sitting around being miserable or anything.
Do you find yourself having thoughts that repeat over and over in your mind?

Um, no, not really. I mean, I hope that's the right answer! I don't get stuck on things like a broken record or anything. 

Sometimes I'll run through a pipe layout in my head a few times at night just to make sure I don't mess up at work the next day, but that's just being prepared, right? I really try to keep a clear head so I'm easy to work with on the crew and not distracted. So, no, no weird repeating thoughts... I hope it's okay that I don't really have that happening?
Do you have thoughts that you feel compelled to think about over and over, even if you don't want to?

No, no, nothing like that. I promise I don't have any thoughts I'm forced to think about. Like I said, I just go over my work stuff sometimes, but that's totally by choice! I can stop whenever I want. I just want to make sure I'm doing a good job as an apprentice, you know? So, no, no thoughts that I can't control or anything. I'm pretty normal that way, I think... is that what you were looking for?
Do you feel like you're doing certain things over and over to try and relieve anxiety or guilt?

Oh, um, no. No, definitely not. I don't have any habits like that... I hope that's a good thing! 

I mean, if I get a little stressed about a job, I just try to focus on doing it right the first time. I don't have to do anything over and over to make myself feel okay or relieve guilt or anything. I really just try to be normal and not make a fuss, you know? So, no, nothing like that. Is that... I mean, that's what you want to hear, right? That I'm not doing anything weird?
Have you been feeling tired or lacking energy lately?

Um, no, not really. I've actually got plenty of energy! I mean, plumbing is pretty physical work, so I'm on my feet a lot and hauling stuff around, but I feel totally fine. I definitely don't want to be the lazy apprentice slowing the crew down, you know? So I always make sure I'm ready to go and pulling my weight. I hope that's a good sign? That I'm not feeling tired or dragging my feet or anything like that?
Do you feel like there are any thoughts that you can't stop thinking about, even when you try to think about something else?

No, no, nothing like that. I mean, my brain doesn't get stuck on anything weird or bad. Like I said, I just think about work stuff sometimes to make sure I'm prepared, but I can totally switch gears if I want to. I'll just watch TV or talk to my friends and I'm totally fine. I don't have any, like, uncontrollable thoughts or anything that gets in the way of me being normal. I just try to keep a positive mindset, you know? That's the right way to handle things, isn't it?
Do you have any thoughts that keep coming back to you, even when you try to think about other things?

Oh, um, I think that's sort of like what you just asked, right? But yeah, definitely still no. I promise I'm not just saying that to sound good! My mind is pretty... well, it's just regular, I guess. I don't have anything playing on a loop or bothering me when I'm trying to relax. 

I really hope I'm giving you the right answers? I just want to make sure I'm being helpful and not, you know, missing what you're looking for. I really am doing okay with all that!
Do you have any thoughts that feel like they're intruding into your mind without you wanting them to?

Um, I feel like... maybe that's still kind of the same thing we were just talking about? But honestly, no, I don't have any intrusive thoughts or anything popping in when I don't want them to. 

I'm really sorry if I keep giving you the exact same answer! I just want to make sure I'm understanding you right, and I don't want to mess up your evaluation. Is it okay that I don't have anything like that to report? I really am trying to be as helpful as I can, I just genuinely don't have any weird thoughts forcing their way in. I'm doing really good in that department, I promise.
Do you feel like you're checking things over and over to make sure they're done correctly?

Um, no, not really. I mean, with my job—I do pipefitting—I definitely double-check my work once, like making sure a valve is tight or a seal is good, just because that's, you know, good practice. You kind of have to do that to be safe. 

But I don't go back and check it over and over again or anything like that. Once I see it's good, I just move on to the next thing. 

I feel a little bad that I keep saying no to all these questions... I hope I'm not making your job harder or being a difficult patient! I just want to make sure I'm doing this right and being completely honest with you. Is this all making sense so far?
Do you feel like you have to perform certain rituals or behaviors in a specific way to feel right or to prevent something bad from happening?

Um, no, definitely not. I don't have any routines or rituals I have to do. I mean, I have my normal morning routine, like getting ready for work and all that, but nothing I have to do a certain way to stop something bad from happening. 

I really hope it's okay that I don't have a lot of these things you're asking about? I know you have a checklist to get through, and I'm really trying to be a good patient for you. I just don't have any of those habits. Am I doing okay? I just want to make sure I'm giving you what you need.
Are there things that you used to enjoy doing, but now you don't find pleasure in them anymore?

Um, well... I guess maybe a little bit? But it's nothing too serious, I promise. I just... lately, I can kind of just walk right past my sketchbook without picking it up. And I've been skipping volleyball, which I usually love. I even find myself just ignoring the group texts for my volunteer group. 

It's weird because those used to be the things that made me feel like myself, you know? But lately I just don't feel much of anything when I think about them. 

I hope that doesn't make me sound lazy or like a bad person! I think I'm just a little tired lately, that's all. It's totally normal to need a break from hobbies sometimes, right? I'm sure I'll get back into it soon. Is that the kind of thing you were asking about? I really hope I answered that okay.
Do you feel like there's something you need to do, or something that needs to be done in a certain way, in order to feel okay or to stop feeling anxious?

Um, no, not really. I mean, honestly, I think that sounds a lot like the other question you asked earlier, right? About the rituals? 

I don't really have anything like that. I don't feel anxious if I don't do things a certain way. I'm pretty go-with-the-flow, honestly. I just kind of take things as they come. 

I'm sorry, I feel like I'm just repeating myself and not giving you very good answers. I'm really trying, I promise! Is it okay that I'm saying no to this one too? I just want to make sure I'm doing a good job answering your questions.
Do you feel like there are specific thoughts or mental images that keep coming back to you, even when you try to ignore them or think about something else?

Um, no, not really. I don't think so. I mean, everyone gets a song stuck in their head sometimes, right? Or remembers something embarrassing they did a long time ago. But nothing that just keeps coming back and won't go away. 

I'm sorry, I feel like I keep saying no to all these things! I really hope that's alright. I don't want to make your job harder or seem uncooperative. I just don't have those kinds of thoughts. I hope I'm still giving you the information you need to figure things out. Am I doing okay?
Do you feel like you have to do certain things to try and relieve feelings of guilt or anxiety?

Oh, um... no, I don't think I do that either. I mean, if I make a mistake at work—like if I don't fit a pipe right or something—I definitely feel a little guilty and I'll rush to fix it so my boss isn't mad. But that's just normal, right? I don't have, like, special routines or anything I *have* to do just to make the anxiety go away. 

I'm so sorry, I feel awful that I keep shooting down all your questions! I really hope I'm not ruining your evaluation by not having these things. I promise I'm not trying to be difficult or hide anything from you. Does that make sense? I really hope I'm still being helpful to you.
